independent_solutions.solver_a:
1. Place a point charge +Q at the center of the base of the square pyramid.
2. By symmetry, imagine a second identical pyramid placed inverted below the first one to form a regular octahedron.
3. The charge Q is now at the center of the octahedron.
independent_solutions.solver_b:
Imagine placing another identical pyramid upside down below the base to enclose the charge at the center.
By symmetry, the total flux Q/varepsilon_0 is divided equally between the upper half-space and lower half-space.
Flux through the 4 upper faces is Q/(2varepsilon_0).
